subject: storytime
title: Curious George words
about: A little monkey who has to know about everything leaves the jungle with a man in a big yellow hat, and his curiosity lands him in one scrape after another in the big city. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: H. A. Rey
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A curious little monkey, a yellow hat and a city full of trouble to get into.
